import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long best_num = 0, best_den = 1;
        long i = 1;
        while (i <= n) {
            long temp = (x * i) / y;
            long diff1 = x * i - temp * y;
            long diff2 = (temp + 1) * y - x * i;
            if (diff1 > diff2) temp += 1;
            long left = best_den * (x * i - temp * y);
            long right = i * (x * best_den - y * best_num);
            if (left * left < right * right) {
                best_num = temp;
                best_den = i;
            }
            ++i;
        }
        System.out.println(best_num + "/" + best_den);
    }
}
